value.rationale: The Pólya concentration is a natural measure of dependence/overdispersion. The proof supplies a strong all-threshold finite-sample ordering of the Wald–Wolfowitz run statistic and uniquely identifies a structurally constrained alternating equality pattern for all concentration comparisons; this is not a moment formula or routine parameter insertion. It can be used to compare null run-test distributions under exchangeable dependence, subject to the theorem limits.
